form:FormGroup.label: Select the parent folder
form:FormGroup.helpText: The folder that the document(s) will be moved into.

form:FormGroup.label: Permissions
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: All but Source make you an owner. Default is Destination.

form:HelpHTML.p: Determines the document's permissions and ownership after it has been moved.

ul.li: None - Removes all current permissions. Ignores permissions of the destination folder. You will be the owner of the moved document if not already.
Source - Keep the current permissions and ownership as they are.
Destination - Removes all current permissions. Adds the permissions of the destination folder. You will be the owner of the moved document if not already.
Combined - Keep the current permissions and add the permissions of the destination folder. You will be the owner of the moved document if not already.
